item.title: US tax agency broke privacy law ‘approximately 42,695 times’, judge says
item.description: Federal judge rules that the Internal Revenue Service violated its code by giving immigration agency confidential data.

item.title: ‘Open war’: Pakistan says ‘patience has run out’ as it bombs Afghanistan
item.description: Both sides say Pakistan has bombed targets in Kabul, Kandahar and Paktia in an escalation of recent tit-for-tat attacks.

item.description: Pakistani and Afghan officials have both declared full military operations as border clashes intensify.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,464
item.description: These are the key developments from day 1,464 of Russia’s war on Ukraine.

item.title: In Gaza, when money is scarce, every choice counts: Bank, cash, or credit?
item.description: Palestinians in the devastated enclave struggle to manage their daily lives amid shortage of cash caused by war.

item.title: Canadian PM Carney heads to India on ‘significant’ trip to consolidate ties
item.description: Carney's trip comes at a time when he's looking for new markets for Canadian exports to diversify from the US.

item.title: Solidarity with Palestinians questioned as Indonesian troops set for Gaza
item.description: President Prabowo Subianto is trying to expand Indonesia's global standing, but Indonesians question his role in Gaza.

item.description: Hamas says latest attacks show Israel's 'blatant disregard for the efforts of mediators' and 'the Peace Council'.

item.description: Countries around the world are urging the warring parties to show restraint.

item.title: ‘No longer a threat’: How Canada U-turned on India ahead of Carney visit
